headline: Minimum garment wage set at Tk17,000 after vote, workers accept decision despite dissatisfaction
summary: A minimum wage for garment workers was set at Tk17,000 after a vote. A workers' representative accepted the decision despite dissatisfaction and warned that those engaging in illegal protests will be responsible for their actions.
why: Garment manufacturing is Bangladesh's largest export industry, so changes to minimum wages affect production costs for global apparel brands sourcing from the country.
